001package pkg_engine;
002
003import java.io.File;
004import java.io.FileOutputStream;
005import java.io.IOException;
006import java.io.InputStream;
007import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
008import java.net.URL;

011/**
012 * Downloads game assets from the ESIEE web server and stores them locally.
013 *
014 * <p>On each launch, checks which assets are missing from the local {@code assets/} folder and
015 * downloads them from the remote server. Files already present are skipped. Each download is
016 * attempted up to {@value #aMaxRetries} times before being marked as failed. If any downloads fail,
017 * the game continues in offline mode with whatever assets are available.
018 *
019 * @author Barnabe Jouanard
020 * @version 2026.04.17
021 */
022public class AssetManager {
023    /** URL of the asset location. */
024    private static final String aAssetsUrl = "https://perso.esiee.fr/~jouanarb/assets/";
025
026    /** Maximum number of download attempts per file before giving up. */
027    private static final int aMaxRetries = 3;
028
029    /** Local directory where assets are stored. */
030    private static final String aAssetsFolder = "Images";
031
032    /** Current filename being downloaded. */
033    private String aCurrentFile = "";
034
035    /** Current progress count. */
036    private int aCurrentProgress = 0;
037
038    /** Reference to the loading screen used for progress updates. */
039    private LoadingScreen aLoadingScreen;
040
041    /** Flag indicating whether the download phase is complete. */
042    private boolean aIsComplete = false;
043
044    /** Error message if any downloads failed (null if all succeeded). */
045    private String aErrorMessage = null;
046
047    /** All asset filenames to download. */
048    private String[] aAssets = {
049        "home.gif",
050        "home_map.jpeg",
051        "littleroot town.gif",
052        "littleroot_map.jpeg",
053        "no map.jpeg",
054        "oldale town.gif",
055        "oldale town_map.jpeg",
056        "petalburg city.gif",
057        "petalburg city_map.jpeg",
058        "petalburg woods.gif",
059        "petalburg woods_map.jpeg",

061        "route101_map.jpeg",
062        "route 102.gif",
063        "route102_map.jpeg",
064        "rustboro city.gif",
065        "rustboro city_map.jpeg",
066        "sky pillar_map.jpeg",
067        "sky pillar.gif",
068        "cascade.gif",
069        "cascade_map.jpeg",
070        "lose screen.png",
071        "trainer_battle.png",
072        "Javier_battle.png",
073        "Zucko_battle.png",
074        "Ichigo_battle.png",
075        "Rayquaza_battle.png",
076        "Blastoise solo.png",
077        "Blastoise dammage.gif",
078        "Charizard solo.png",
079        "Charizard dammage.gif",
080        "Dragonite solo.png",
081        "Dragonite dammage.gif",
082        "Garchomp solo.png",
083        "Garchomp dammage.gif",
084        "Greninja solo.png",
085        "Greninja dammage.gif",

104
105    /** Total number of assets to download. */
106    private int aTotalAssets = aAssets.length;
107
108    /** Creates a new asset manager. */
109    public AssetManager() {
110        // ensure the assets directory exists
111        File vAssetsFolder = new File(aAssetsFolder);
112        if (!vAssetsFolder.exists()) {
113            vAssetsFolder.mkdirs();
114        }
115    } // AssetManager()
116
117    /**
118     * Sets the loading screen used to report download progress.
119     *
120     * @param pLoadingScreen the loading screen instance to update
121     */
122    public void setLoadingScreen(final LoadingScreen pLoadingScreen) {
123        this.aLoadingScreen = pLoadingScreen;
124    } // setLoadingScreen()
125
126    /**
127     * Checks whether all assets are already present in the local folder.
128     *
129     * @return {@code true} if every file in {@link #aAssets} exists locally
130     */
131    public boolean allAssetsDownloaded() {
132        for (String vFileName : aAssets) {
133            File vFile = new File(aAssetsFolder + File.separator + vFileName);
134            if (!vFile.exists()) {
135                return false;
136            }
137        }
138        return true;
139    } // allAssetsDownloaded()
140
141    /**
142     * Returns the total number of assets that need to be downloaded.
143     *
144     * @return count of files not yet present in the local folder
145     */
146    public int countMissingAssets() {
147        int vCount = 0;
148        for (String vFileName : aAssets) {
149            File vFile = new File(aAssetsFolder + File.separator + vFileName);
150            if (!vFile.exists()) {
151                vCount++;
152            }
153        }
154        return vCount;
155    } // countMissingAssets()
156
157    /**
158     * Downloads all missing assets from the assets url.
159     *
160     * <p>Each file is attempted up to {@value #aMaxRetries} times. If a file still fails after all
161     * retries, it is skipped and the game will run in offline mode (missing images appear as blank
162     * panels).
163     */
164    public void downloadAssets() {
165        int vFailCount = 0;
166
167        for (int vI = 0; vI < aTotalAssets; vI++) {
168            String vFileName = aAssets[vI];
169            File vLocalFile = new File(aAssetsFolder + File.separator + vFileName);
170
171            if (vLocalFile.exists()) {
172                // already stored locally, skip
173                this.aCurrentFile = vFileName;
174                this.aCurrentProgress = vI + 1;
175                continue;
176            }
177
178            boolean vSuccess = false;
179            for (int vAttempt = 1; vAttempt <= aMaxRetries; vAttempt++) {
180                vSuccess = this.downloadFile(vFileName, vLocalFile);
181                if (vSuccess) {
182                    break;
183                }
184            }
185
186            if (!vSuccess) {
187                vFailCount++;
188                System.out.println("Failed to download " + vFileName + " after " + aMaxRetries + " attempts.");
189            }
190
191            this.aCurrentFile = vFileName;
192            this.aCurrentProgress = vI + 1;
193        }
194
195        if (vFailCount > 0) {
196            this.aErrorMessage = vFailCount + " file(s) could not be downloaded. Running in offline mode.\n" + "Try restarting the game with Wi‑Fi, or consider downloading the" + " offline version from the website.";
197            System.out.println(aErrorMessage);
198        }
199        this.aIsComplete = true;
200    } // downloadAssets()
201
202    /**
203     * Downloads a single file from the remote server to the local path.
204     *
205     * @param pFileName the filename on the server (e.g. {@code "home.gif"})
206     * @param pLocalFile the local destination file
207     * @return {@code true} if the download succeeded; {@code false} otherwise
208     */
209    private boolean downloadFile(final String pFileName, final File pLocalFile) {
210        HttpURLConnection vConnection = null;
211        try {
212            // URL-encode the filename (handles spaces -> %20).
213            String vEncodedName = URLEncoder.encode(pFileName, "UTF-8").replace("+", "%20");
214            URL vUrl = java.net.URI.create(aAssetsUrl + vEncodedName).toURL();
215
216            vConnection = (HttpURLConnection) vUrl.openConnection();
217            vConnection.setConnectTimeout(10000);
218            vConnection.setReadTimeout(10000);
219            vConnection.setRequestMethod("GET");
220
221            int vResponseCode = vConnection.getResponseCode();
222            if (vResponseCode != HttpURLConnection.HTTP_OK) {
223                System.out.println("HTTP " + vResponseCode + " for: " + pFileName);
224                return false;
225            }
226
227            try (InputStream vInput = vConnection.getInputStream();
228                FileOutputStream vOutput = new FileOutputStream(pLocalFile)) {
229                vInput.transferTo(vOutput);
230            }
231
232            return true;
233        } catch (IOException vException) {
234            System.out.println("Download error for " + pFileName + ": " + vException.getMessage());
235            // Clean up any partial file.
236            if (pLocalFile.exists()) {
237                pLocalFile.delete();
238            }
239            return false;
240        } finally {
241            if (vConnection != null) {
242                vConnection.disconnect();
243            }
244            if (this.aLoadingScreen != null) {
245                this.aLoadingScreen.setProgressBar();
246            }
247        }
248    } // downloadFile()
249
250    /**
251     * Returns the name of the most recent file processed by {@link #downloadAssets()}.
252     *
253     * @return the current filename (may be empty)
254     */
255    public String getCurrentFile() {
256        return aCurrentFile;
257    } // getCurrentFile()
258
259    /**
260     * Returns the 1-based index of the most recent asset processed by {@link #downloadAssets()}.
261     *
262     * @return progress count in the range {@code [0..getTotalAssets()]}
263     */
264    public int getCurrentProgress() {
265        return aCurrentProgress;
266    } // getCurrentProgress()
267
268    /**
269     * Returns the total number of assets configured for download.
270     *
271     * @return total assets count
272     */
273    public int getTotalAssets() {
274        return aTotalAssets;
275    } // getTotalAssets()
276
277    /**
278     * Indicates whether the asset download phase has completed.
279     *
280     * @return {@code true} once {@link #downloadAssets()} has finished
281     */
282    public boolean isComplete() {
283        return aIsComplete;
284    } // isComplete()
285
286    /**
287     * Returns a human-readable error message when at least one download failed.
288     *
289     * @return error message, or {@code null} when no errors occurred
290     */
291    public String getErrorMessage() {
292        return aErrorMessage;
293    } // getErrorMessage()
294} // AssetManager
